Acme Robotics Warranty Policy

Every AcmeMover robot ships with a standard two-year limited warranty that covers
defects in materials and workmanship. The warranty period begins on the date of
delivery.

Battery packs are covered separately under a one-year warranty. Batteries that drop
below 70 percent of their rated capacity within the first year will be replaced at
no cost.

The warranty does not cover damage caused by water immersion, operation outside the
rated temperature range of 0 to 40 degrees Celsius, or unauthorized modifications.

To file a warranty claim, contact support@acmerobotics.example with your robot's
serial number and a description of the issue. Claims are typically processed within
five business days.
